knownFindingsNote: Muse's findings suite asserts its own proposals. Sorted by the Board on Nov 10 2026 (issue 355) and trimmed by issue 358: the 26 opinion tests and the 5 stale tests are out of the gate, leaving the listed bug ids and the ruled-not-built ids as the only accepted failures. Issue 1505 (Nov 22 2026) took EVT-1 and MOD-2 off the list (their tests now read today's data shapes and pass), retired KIT-1 and NEM-6 as stale, and left ROS-9 (waits on Ryan) and UI-5. UI-5 is tagged stale-for-browser in issue 387: its findings test reads the frozen browser screen, and the product's Godot check is godot/scenes/battle/test/wing_cancel_test.gd. A listed id that passes, or no longer runs, fails the row until it is taken off this list. checksCeiling and driftDifferedCeiling may only go down; a count above either fails the row.
